recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless a future work-group decision narrows DocumentReference.subject again.
issue_request: FHIR-32576 was a Published/Persuasive Orders and Observations R5 change request to make DocumentReference.subject Any because document references can be about resources beyond the former enumerated subject list.
initial_application: The issue was applied by c585283d64d014e0629d680fa7ad132c2acdaf36 and merged via PR #1689 as c06738ed3ea3eaf4361b44368fb30e5d481498bc, replacing the prior enumerated target profiles with http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Resource.
additional_context: FHIR-28366 is a duplicate HealthcareService-focused request resolved through FHIR-32576. The originating Zulip thread and OO WGM minutes support the broadening, and bounded Jira/Zulip/Confluence searches found no later conflicting reversal.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because source/fhir.ini includes DocumentReference in the active build, source/documentreference/structuredefinition-DocumentReference.xml already sets DocumentReference.subject targetProfile to Resource, and the generic DocumentReference-subject search parameter has no restrictive target list.
